description: AdRoll documented audience image pixels carry advertiser and pixel identities in the path, plus the configured audience segment in name. Exact image routing prevents JavaScript and adjacent collectors from inheriting this audience contract.

params.name: advertiser_id
params.description: The published image template carries this identity in the path. Its opaque grammar remains open.

params.name: pixel_id
params.description: The published image template carries this identity in the path. Its opaque grammar remains open.

params.name: name
params.description: The documented audience image URL carries the configured segment identity.
